verdict.rationale: Adyen's first-party tipping docs describe several gratuity options: tipping from the POS app, tipping from the terminal, and tipping on the receipt. When the POS app sends a suggested tip, the shopper can accept, change, or decline it on the terminal, which covers the core of collecting tips on the reader with custom amounts. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of configuring percentage-based tip options or smart amounts, detail on where merchant-ops configures the terminal tipping screen, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
